$comment: Session title templates. The title is read when the agent is idle, so every label names the HUMAN's next action. Tokens: {pr} -> ' #12' or '', {progress} -> ' 3/10' or ''. Labels are UI strings rendered in ONE language for every status and activity (SESSION_TITLE_LANG, default en); the free-text subject follows the session language. 'modes' lists where a status may be chosen; 'next' is the guidance the agent reads.

freshness.$comment: Age dot prefixed to every title: '🟡 🔀 À merger #12 · 042-webhook'. Age = now - lastActivityAt of the session (a rename does not touch lastActivityAt). The first level whose belowMinutes exceeds the age wins; the last level has no bound. The sweep frequency lives in the user config (session-title.sh config), not here.

activities.$comment: What the AGENT is doing while it has the floor, shown after the blue working dot: '🔵 🛠️ Coding 5/14 · 295-parent-acts'. Labels follow SESSION_TITLE_LANG like the statuses (default en). Chosen by the agent when a prompt arrives.

investigating.when: reading code, logs or docs to understand

planning.when: writing a plan or a task list

testing.when: running or writing tests, trying the change

reviewing.when: reviewing a diff, a PR or a document

writing.when: writing docs, a report or a message

to-clarify.next: spec.md holds [NEEDS CLARIFICATION]; human answers or runs /speckit.clarify.

to-plan.next: spec.md is ready; human reviews it, then /speckit.plan.

to-split.next: plan.md is ready; human reviews it, then /speckit.tasks.

to-implement.next: tasks.md has open tasks; human runs /speckit.implement or says continue.

to-read.next: The agent answered; nothing changed on disk. Human reads the answer.

decide.next: The turn ended on a question or a choice only the human can make.

paused.next: Work stopped unfinished (interrupted, budget, context); human says continue.

to-test.next: A change has a surface the human should exercise (UI, endpoint, job, CLI), locally or on staging.

to-ship.next: Work is done but uncommitted, unpushed or without a PR; human approves commit / push / PR.

to-merge.next: A PR is open; human reviews and merges it.

merged.next: The sweep saw the PR merged while the session was idle; human tests the change or archives the session. Set by the sweep, never at Stop (the agent judges to-test or to-close there).

to-close.next: Merged and nothing left to exercise, or the human confirmed it works; human archives the session and the branch.

blocked.next: Waiting on something outside the session (a colleague, an access, a deploy).

working.next: Fallback activity while the agent works; prefer a verb from 'activities'. Set when a prompt arrives, never at Stop.

closed.next: Nothing left; the session can be archived.
